title: Crypto Ticker — live cryptocurrency prices (Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana…) in your forum
author: LoadFoundry

posts.author: LoadFoundry
posts.text:
Summary

Discourse Crypto Ticker shows live cryptocurrency prices (Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, memecoins.) as a ticker or cards. Choose from 6 positions and 4 styles, and pick the coins from a built-in admin page.

Repository Link

      github.com

  GitHub - LoadFoundryHQ/discourse-crypto-ticker: Load Foundry Crypto Ticker - live crypto prices...

Load Foundry Crypto Ticker - live crypto prices plus stocks & indexes, with an admin picker and a multilingual UI. A Discourse plugin.

By Load Foundry - https://loadfoundry.com/

The repository moved from bitforo/discourse-crypto-ticker to LoadFoundryHQ/discourse-crypto-ticker. The old URL redirects, so existing installs keep working, and your settings (crypto_ticker_*) are preserved.

Install Guide

      Install plugins on a self-hosted site Self-Hosting

     This guide assumes that you have a self-hosted standard installation. We only support the standard method of install here, so these instructions assume you have a standard install.

 This guide only applies to self-hosted Discourse instances. If you are using a managed hosting service, the available plugins are controlled by your hosting provider. For example, on our hosting these specific plugins are available by hosting tier.

 As of mid-2025, many p…

Features

- Live prices + 24h change for the coins you choose (public CoinGecko API, no API key needed).

- 6 positions - below the site header (default), above/below the topic list, top/end of a topic, or the left sidebar.

- 4 styles - Classic and Dark (scrolling strip, pauses on hover), Minimal (flat, wraps) and Cards (static grid).

- Coin picker - an admin page with the top 20 coins and a search over Binance-listed coins.

Configuration

Add the plugin to your containers/app.yml and rebuild:

```yaml
hooks:
  after_code:
    - exec:
        cd: $home/plugins
        cmd:
          - git clone https://github.com/LoadFoundryHQ/discourse-crypto-ticker.git

cd /var/discourse
./launcher rebuild app

posts.author: LoadFoundry
posts.text:
Update — v1.7.4

Load Foundry Crypto Ticker got a big update:

- Stocks & indexes — show stock and index prices (Yahoo Finance) next to crypto, picked from the admin.

- New admin UI with independent tabs: Settings · Coins · Stocks · Indexes.

- Multilingual UI (English / Español / Português) with a language selector in the plugin settings.

- Coins: quick-select Top 10 / Top 20; the top 10 are preselected by default (you can deselect any).

- “Show change” and “stocks & indexes” are enabled by default.

title: What are the plans for product-specific pricing table settings
author: Nelson-N

posts.author: Nelson-N
posts.text:
Awesome job on the plugin. Setup is easy and straightforward.

Are there any plans to have the following settings available at the Product - Level?

- discourse subscriptions pricing table id

- discourse subscriptions pricing table enabled

Currently, these are global settings. It only allows for 1 pricing table, but there might be use case where there’s multiple products that each have their own pricing table in Stripe and a desire to use Stripe Checkout.

Example:

-

Product 1

** Bronze Plan - $10

** Silver Plan - $20

** Gold Plan - $50

-

Product 2

** Bronze Plan - $50

** Silver Plan - $100

** Gold Plan - $250

Ideally, Product 1 and Product 2 would have separate pricing tables. The ‘Subscribe’ button for a given product on the ‘/s’ page would launch Stripe Checkout.

posts.author: blake
posts.text:
Nelson-N:

Are there any plans to have the following settings available at the Product - Level?

Not currently, but thanks for bringing this up as I never even considered it! Likely something that could be done at some point, but can’t guarantee any sort of time table and the moment.
